title: API Documentation
descriptionPart1: Official API reference and OIDC discovery documentation for

oidc.name: OIDC Discovery
oidc.description: Returns the OpenID Connect discovery document containing issuer, endpoints, and supported scopes/claims.
oidc.response: JSON object with OpenID Provider metadata.

auth.name: Authorization Endpoint
auth.description: Initiates the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow.

params.redirect_uri: Where to redirect the user after auth.
params.state: Opaque value for maintaining state to mitigate CSRF.

auth.response: Redirects to the redirect_uri with a `code` and `state`.

token.name: Token Endpoint
token.description: Exchanges an authorization code or refresh token for access tokens.

params.code: The authorization code (if grant_type is authorization_code).
params.redirect_uri: Must match the original redirect URI.

token.response: JSON object containing access_token, id_token, and refresh_token.

userinfo.name: UserInfo Endpoint
userinfo.description: Retrieves claims about the authenticated end-user.

params.authorization: Bearer token containing the access token.

userinfo.response: JSON object containing user claims (sub, name, email, etc.).

jwks.name: JWKS Endpoint
jwks.description: Returns the JSON Web Key Set used to sign ID tokens.
jwks.response: JSON Web Key Set containing public keys.

revoke.name: Token Revocation Endpoint
revoke.description: Revokes an active access or refresh token.

params.token: The token you want to revoke.

logout.name: Logout Endpoint
logout.description: Ends the user session at the identity provider.

params.id_token_hint: The ID Token previously issued to the client.
params.post_logout_redirect_uri: Where to redirect after logging out.
params.state: Opaque value passed back to the redirect URI.
